newsitem.title: CHINA: China motorcycle output 9.29 million in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China motorcycle output 9.29 million in 1996.

text.p: China produced 9.29 million motorcylces in 1996, making it the top motorbike producer in the world for the fourth straight year, the Worker's Daily said on Thursday.
Chinese motorcycle makers had basically satisfied domestic demand and were now starting to compete internationally, the newspaper said but gave no further details.
China has about 300 motorcycle producers with a total output capacity of 20 million units a year, but relatively few firms make more than 100,000 a year.
Motorcycle output was 7.83 million units in 1995, but China sold only 6.1 million of those, official figures say.
